items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: He says, well, he says, I wish I had John Noyiff. He says, you really got courage.

ctx.x: They just happened to be there, huh? No, to be there for the past examination themselves, you see? I am by myself. You see? New members. I just got in. New members. So, they had a little stand there with four members on there that writes the cards for you. In fact, they were the, what would you call them, the professors or something. If you pass or you don't. Right, they were the judges. The judges. Yeah. And they had a piano there and a professor right there with you. See? They called my name and I took my bass…
